files.content: # Orbiting cards — Style Prompt > A talking head in their own room, and eight portrait photo cards travelling round them on a tilted ring: the cards at the back of the ring pass behind the head, small and high; the cards at the front sweep across the chest, big and low. Nothing else moves but the ring and the speaker. On top, a two-line title in heavy sans: a white line, and a second line on a solid box. The ring never stops; beats change only the title (and, if wanted, the pictures on the cards). ## 1. Essence, and what it is not 1. **One continuous orbit.** The ring turns at a constant 35.5° per second from the first frame to the last, the same direction all film. The cards are already in place on frame 1; nothing flies in. 2. **Depth from the speaker.** The speaker sits at the ring's depth zero: every card with negative depth is drawn behind the person (a cutout), every card with positive depth in front. That crossing is the whole trick. 3. **The title does the talking.** One white line plus one boxed line, centred near the top, changed per beat. The box carries the key words. 4. **Pictures are the content.** The cards show the user's own photos, works, screenshots or products; they are portrait (11:18) with a cream frame. Not a carousel of slides (no card stops at the front, no flips, no zoom into a card). Not a 3D product spin (the subject is a person speaking). Not a collage wall (cards keep moving and keep their size by depth only). ## 2. Materials & rendering - **Footage is the ground**, full bleed 9:16: the user's clip from `list_media` as `

# Orbiting cards: beat plan

Default length 15 s. Tempo per beat (seconds): short 2.5, medium 3.5, long 4.5.

## hook

- en: speaker in frame from frame 1, eight photo cards already orbiting; the claim as a white line plus a boxed second line on top
- id: pembicara sudah di bingkai sejak awal, delapan kartu foto sudah berputar; klaim jadi baris putih plus baris kedua berkotak di atas

## problem

- en: the ring keeps turning; title swaps to the pain, its key words boxed; cards show the messy 'before' pictures
- id: cincin terus berputar; judul berganti ke masalahnya, kata kuncinya berkotak; kartu menampilkan foto 'sebelum' yang berantakan

## fact

- en: the fact as the two-line title over the turning ring; one card per piece of evidence, passing in front of the chest
- id: fakta jadi judul dua baris di atas cincin yang berputar; satu kartu per bukti, lewat di depan dada

## step

- en: the steps named in one boxed line; each card shows one step's picture as it crosses the front of the ring
- id: langkah disebut dalam satu baris berkotak; tiap kartu menampilkan gambar satu langkah saat lewat di depan cincin

## compare

- en: cards alternate the two options (before/after, A/B) around the ring; the title names the winner in its box
- id: kartu bergantian dua pilihan (sebelum/sesudah, A/B) mengelilingi pembicara; judul menyebut pemenangnya di kotak

## number

- en: the figure alone in the boxed line, the unit in the white line above; cards keep orbiting as the proof
- id: angka sendirian di baris berkotak, satuannya di baris putih di atasnya; kartu tetap berputar sebagai bukti

## proof

- en: the cards become the user's real results (screenshots, works, photos of customers); title quotes the result
- id: kartu jadi hasil asli pengguna (tangkapan layar, karya, foto pelanggan); judul mengutip hasilnya

## offer

- en: the product and price in the title, price in the box; cards show the product from different sides
- id: produk dan harga di judul, harga di kotak; kartu menampilkan produk dari berbagai sisi

## cta

- en: the action in the white line, contact in the box, held at least 2 s while the ring keeps turning
- id: ajakan di baris putih, kontak di kotak, diam minimal 2 dtk sementara cincin tetap berputar

## payoff

- en: the lesson as the closing title, its key words boxed, held 2 s; cards show the finished results
- id: pelajaran jadi judul penutup, kata kuncinya berkotak, diam 2 dtk; kartu menampilkan hasil jadinya

    <style>
      @font-face { font-family: "Inter"; src: url("data:font/woff2;base64,"); font-weight: 600; }
      @font-face { font-family: "Inter"; src: url("data:font/woff2;base64,"); font-weight: 800; }
      /* Token brand (recipes/README.md): brand mengganti dua belas nilai pertama. */
      :root {
        --latar: #171917; --latar-2: #24221d; --utama: #f6f2e9; --aksen: #ffcf5a;
        --teks: #ffffff; --teks-redup: #cfc8bb; --teks-di-utama: #121412; --teks-di-aksen: #121412;

        --r-kayu: #4a2e1d; --r-kayu2: #2a1810; --r-gelap: #120c09; --r-tirai: #d9d0c1; --r-tirai2: #b9ae9c;
        --r-lampu: #ffc77a; --r-jendela: #1c2125; --r-lantai: #3b2416;
        --k-kulit: #c98f6b; --k-kulit2: #a66f51; --k-rambut: #2a1c15; --k-baju: #141a24; --k-baju2: #222b38;
        --k-bibir: #7a3a36; --k-mata: #1b1310; --k-putih: #f3ece4; --k-laptop: #c3c4c8; --k-laptop2: #8e9095;
        --kartu-bingkai: #f6f0e5;
        --p-langit: #9fd0f2; --p-biru: #1f3f9c; --p-pink: #f3bcc4; --p-pink2: #e2899d; --p-merah: #c41c3f;
        --p-kuning: #f6d24c; --p-hijau: #3f8f4e; --p-krem: #f3e6cf; --p-coklat: #6b3f22; --p-oranye: #f08a3c;
        --p-ungu: #6b4bb8; --p-laut: #2e6f8f;
      }
      * { margin: 0; padding: 0; box-sizing: border-box; }
      html, body { width: 1080px; height: 1920px; overflow: hidden; background: var(--latar); }
      #root { position: relative; width: 100%; height: 100%; overflow: hidden; background: var(--latar); color: var(--teks); font-family: var(--font-isi); }
      /* Ruang pengganti footage, dilukis sekali: atap kayu, tirai, jendela gelap, lampu hangat. */
      .ruang { position: absolute; inset: 0; background: linear-gradient(var(--r-kayu2), var(--r-gelap) 70%, var(--r-lantai)); }
      .atap { position: absolute; left: -100px; top: -40px; width: 1300px; height: 560px; clip-path: polygon(0 0, 100% 0, 100% 40%, 50% 100%, 0 40%);
        background: repeating-linear-gradient(100deg, var(--r-kayu) 0 46px, var(--r-kayu2) 46px 56px); }
      .jendela { position: absolute; left: -20px; top: 420px; width: 300px; height: 760px; background: var(--r-jendela);
        box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 14px var(--r-kayu2); }
      .tirai { position: absolute; left: 270px; top: 180px; width: 430px; height: 1040px;
        background: repeating-linear-gradient(90deg, var(--r-tirai) 0 34px, var(--r-tirai2) 34px 52px, var(--r-tirai) 52px 70px); opacity: 0.9; }
      .lampu { position: absolute; inset: 0; background: radial-gradient(circle at 930px 880px, color-mix(in oklab, var(--r-lampu) 70%, transparent) 0 40px, color-mix(in oklab, var(--r-lampu) 22%, transparent) 120px, transparent 420px),
        radial-gradient(circle at 160px 1240px, color-mix(in oklab, var(--r-lampu) 18%, transparent), transparent 260px); }
      .orang { position: absolute; left: 0; top: 0; width: 1080px; height: 1920px; z-index: 20; overflow: visible; }
      .kulit { fill: var(--k-kulit); } .kulit2 { fill: var(--k-kulit2); } .rambut { fill: var(--k-rambut); }
      .baju { fill: var(--k-baju); } .baju2 { fill: none; stroke: var(--k-baju2); stroke-width: 10; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; }
      .alis { fill: none; stroke: var(--k-rambut); stroke-width: 13; stroke-linecap: round; }
      .hidung { fill: none; stroke: var(--k-kulit2); stroke-width: 7; stroke-linecap: round; }
      .putih { fill: var(--k-putih); } .mata { fill: var(--k-mata); } .bibir { fill: var(--k-bibir); }
      .laptop { fill: var(--k-laptop); } .laptop2 { fill: var(--k-laptop2); }
      /* Kartu foto: 220 x 360, bingkai krem 3 px, sudut 17 px, bayangan kecil. Posisi diatur skrip (orbit). */
      .kartu { position: absolute; left: 0; top: 0; width: 220px; height: 360px; border: 3px solid var(--kartu-bingkai); border-radius: 17px;
        overflow: hidden; background: var(--p-krem); box-shadow: 0 5px 12px color-mix(in oklab, var(--r-gelap) 22%, transparent); }
      .kartu svg { display: block; width: 100%; height: 100%; }
      /* Judul di atas rekaman: baris putih berbayang, baris kedua di kotak warna utama. */
      .scene { position: absolute; inset: 0; z-index: 40; visibility: hidden; pointer-events: none; }
      #s1 { visibility: visible; }
      .judul { position: absolute; left: 140px; top: 240px; width: 800px; text-align: center; font: 800 65px/1.18 var(--font-judul);
        color: var(--teks); text-shadow: 0 2px 3px color-mix(in oklab, var(--latar) 70%, transparent); }
      .kotak { display: block; width: max-content; margin: 8px auto 0; padding: 0 12px 5px; background: var(--utama); color: var(--teks-di-utama); text-shadow: none; }
      .sorot { position: absolute; left: 0; top: 0; width: 1080px; height: 560px; z-index: 39;
        background: linear-gradient(color-mix(in oklab, var(--latar) 72%, transparent) 30%, transparent); }
    </style>
  </head>
  <body>
    <div id="root" data-composition-id="main" data-start="0" data-duration="15" data-width="1080" data-height="1920" data-fps="30">
      <!-- Footage pengguna: satu <video> klip upl_… dari list_media di bawah,
           lalu cutout orangnya video cutout cut_… dari make_cutout di .orang (z-index 20) dengan waktu yang sama (cutoutTiming). -->
      <div class="ruang"><div class="atap"></div><div class="jendela"></div><div class="tirai"></div><div class="lampu"></div></div>
      <svg class="orang" viewBox="0 0 1080 1920">
        <path class="baju" d="M110 1920 L140 1340 Q165 1190 320 1150 L455 1112 Q540 1160 625 1112 L760 1150 Q915 1190 940 1340 L970 1920 Z" />
        <path class="baju2" d="M455 1116 L498 1196 L540 1158 L582 1196 L625 1116 M540 1158 V1300" />
        <path class="kulit2" d="M474 985 L470 1118 Q540 1168 610 1118 L606 985 Z" />
        <g id="kepala"><g transform="translate(540 1080) scale(0.86) translate(-540 -1080)">
          <ellipse class="kulit2" cx="372" cy="880" rx="28" ry="52" /><ellipse class="kulit2" cx="708" cy="880" rx="28" ry="52" />
          <path class="kulit" d="M540 652 C652 652 712 734 712 864 C712 994 640 1076 540 1076 C440 1076 368 994 368 864 C368 734 428 652 540 652 Z" />
          <path class="rambut" d="M360 860 C342 700 430 604 548 604 C668 604 742 690 722 860 C712 770 668 716 604 704 C548 730 452 732 396 712 C374 760 366 806 360 860 Z" />
          <path class="alis" d="M432 812 q36 -18 74 -4 M574 808 q38 -14 74 4" />
          <g id="mata"><ellipse class="putih" cx="470" cy="862" rx="30" ry="17" /><ellipse class="putih" cx="610" cy="862" rx="30" ry="17" />
            <circle class="mata" cx="472" cy="862" r="13" /><circle class="mata" cx="608" cy="862" r="13" /></g>
          <path class="hidung" d="M540 880 q-10 44 -22 56 q14 10 32 2" />
          <ellipse class="bibir" id="mulut" cx="540" cy="992" rx="48" ry="20" />
        </g></g>
        <!-- laptop di depan badan: bagian rekaman, bukan grafis -->
        <path class="laptop2" d="M20 1600 L880 1640 L900 1920 L0 1920 Z" />
        <path class="laptop" d="M40 1610 L860 1648 L878 1920 L18 1920 Z" />
      </svg>
      <div id="cincin"></div>
      <div class="sorot"></div>
      <div class="scene" id="s1" data-role="hook"><div class="judul" id="j1">Foto HP biasa<span class="kotak">jadi kelihatan mahal.</span></div></div>
      <div class="scene" id="s2" data-role="step"><div class="judul" id="j2">Cukup tiga trik:<span class="kotak">cahaya, sudut, warna.</span></div></div>
      <div class="scene" id="s3" data-role="offer"><div class="judul" id="j3">Kelas Foto HP, 4 sesi<span class="kotak">Rp49rb saja.</span></div></div>
      <div class="scene" id="s4" data-role="cta"><div class="judul" id="j4">Daftar lewat Chat<span class="kotak">0812-3456-7890</span></div></div>
    </div>
    <script>
      const tl = gsap.timeline({ paused: true });
      // Foto di kartu: enam lukisan SVG sederhana (pengganti foto pengguna dari list_media).
      const FOTO = [
        `<rect width="220" height="360" style="fill:var(--p-langit)"/><path d="M0 150 H120 V360 H0 Z" style="fill:var(--p-biru)"/><path d="M120 120 H220 V360 H60 V320 H90 V280 H120 V240 H150 V200 H180 V160 H220" style="fill:var(--p-pink)"/><path d="M120 120 V360" style="stroke:var(--p-pink2);stroke-width:8"/>`,
        `<rect width="220" height="360" style="fill:var(--p-merah)"/><ellipse cx="110" cy="240" rx="92" ry="34" style="fill:var(--p-krem)"/><path d="M50 236 V170 Q110 130 170 170 V236 Q110 262 50 236 Z" style="fill:var(--p-coklat)"/><path d="M50 176 Q110 140 170 176 Q110 206 50 176 Z" style="fill:var(--p-pink)"/><circle cx="110" cy="150" r="12" style="fill:var(--p-merah)"/>`,
        `<rect width="220" height="360" style="fill:var(--p-pink)"/><rect y="250" width="220" height="110" style="fill:var(--p-pink2)"/><path d="M96 260 V120 Q110 96 124 120 V260 Z M60 200 V160 Q72 146 84 160 V214 H96 M160 186 V144 Q148 130 136 144 V200 H124" style="fill:var(--p-hijau)"/>`,
        `<rect width="220" height="360" style="fill:var(--p-oranye)"/><rect width="220" height="150" style="fill:var(--p-kuning)"/><circle cx="110" cy="200" r="54" style="fill:var(--p-krem)"/><rect y="220" width="220" height="140" style="fill:var(--p-laut)"/><path d="M20 260 H200 M50 300 H170" style="stroke:var(--p-krem);stroke-width:6"/>`,
        `<rect width="220" height="360" style="fill:var(--p-coklat)"/><circle cx="110" cy="180" r="76" style="fill:var(--p-krem)"/><circle cx="110" cy="180" r="56" style="fill:var(--p-coklat)"/><path d="M90 180 q20 -30 40 0 q-20 30 -40 0" style="fill:var(--p-krem)"/><path d="M186 180 h22" style="stroke:var(--p-krem);stroke-width:14;stroke-linecap:round"/>`,
        `<rect width="220" height="360" style="fill:var(--p-krem)"/><g style="fill:var(--p-ungu)"><rect x="40" y="120" width="40" height="40"/><rect x="80" y="160" width="40" height="40"/><rect x="40" y="200" width="40" height="40"/></g><g style="fill:var(--p-kuning)"><rect x="120" y="120" width="40" height="40"/><rect x="80" y="200" width="40" height="40"/><rect x="120" y="200" width="40" height="40"/></g><g style="fill:var(--p-merah)"><rect x="80" y="120" width="40" height="40"/><rect x="120" y="160" width="40" height="40"/><rect x="40" y="160" width="40" height="40"/></g><rect x="96" y="80" width="12" height="40" style="fill:var(--p-hijau)"/>`,
      ];
      const URUT = [1, 0, 4, 2, 5, 0, 3, 1];
      const cincin = document.getElementById("cincin");
      const kartu = URUT.map((f) => {
        const el = document.createElement("div");
        el.className = "kartu";
        el.innerHTML = `<svg viewBox="0 0 220 360" preserveAspectRatio="xMidYMid slice">${FOTO[f]}</svg>`;
        return cincin.appendChild(el);
      });
      // Cincin 3D palsu: lingkaran miring dihitung sendiri, diproyeksikan dengan perspektif 1400 px dari (540, 900).
      // Kartu i di sudut 80 - 45i derajat, berputar 35,5 derajat per detik; z < 0 di belakang orang, z > 0 di depan.
      const R = { cx: 540, cy: 1010, rx: 570, ry: 185, rz: 290, p: 1400, ox: 540, oy: 900, w: 220, h: 360, laju: 35.5 };
      const D = Math.PI / 180;
      function orbit(t) {
        kartu.forEach((el, i) => {
          const a = (80 - 45 * i - R.laju * t) * D, sn = Math.sin(a), cs = Math.cos(a), z = R.rz * cs;
          const s = R.p / (R.p - z), x = R.ox + (R.cx + R.rx * sn - R.ox) * s, y = R.oy + (R.cy + R.ry * cs - R.oy) * s;
          const rY = -24 * sn;
          gsap.set(el, { x: x - R.w / 2, y: y - R.h / 2, scaleX: s * Math.cos(rY * D), scaleY: s, skewY: rY * 0.22, rotation: -3 * sn,
            zIndex: z < 0 ? 1 + Math.round((z + R.rz) / 40) : 30 + Math.round(z / 40) });
        });
      }
      // Orang pengganti: kepala mengangguk pelan, berkedip, mulut bicara (jeda di antara kalimat).
      const JEDA = [[4.3, 4.7], [8.4, 8.8], [12.0, 12.4], [14.2, 15]];
      function hidup(t) {
        const diam = JEDA.some(([a, b]) => t > a && t < b);
        const buka = diam ? 0.15 : 0.2 + 0.8 * Math.abs(Math.sin(t * 13.7) * Math.sin(t * 4.1 + 1.3));
        gsap.set("#mulut", { scaleY: buka, transformOrigin: "50% 50%" });
        gsap.set("#kepala", { rotation: 2.2 * Math.sin(t * 1.3), y: 9 * Math.sin(t * 2.6 + 0.5), svgOrigin: "540 1090" });
        const k = (t % 3.4) / 0.16;
        gsap.set("#mata", { scaleY: k < 1 ? 1 - 0.9 * Math.sin(k * Math.PI) : 1, transformOrigin: "50% 50%" });
      }
      const jam = { t: 0 };
      orbit(0); hidup(0);
      tl.to(jam, { t: 15, duration: 15, ease: "none", onUpdate: () => { orbit(jam.t); hidup(jam.t); } }, 0);
      // Judul berganti tiap ketukan; kotak baris kedua menyapu masuk dari tengah.
      const cut = (from, to, at) => tl.set(from, { visibility: "hidden" }, at).set(to, { visibility: "visible" }, at);
      [["#s1", 0], ["#s2", 4.5], ["#s3", 8.6], ["#s4", 12.2]].forEach(([s, at], i, all) => {
        if (i) cut(all[i - 1][0], s, at);
        tl.fromTo(`${s} .judul`, { y: 18, opacity: 0 }, { y: 0, opacity: 1, duration: 0.22, ease: "power2.out" }, at + 0.05);
        tl.fromTo(`${s} .kotak`, { scaleX: 0 }, { scaleX: 1, duration: 0.2, ease: "power3.out" }, at + 0.16);
      });
      window.__timelines = window.__timelines || {};
      window.__timelines.main = tl;
    </script>
  </body>
</html>

      .kulit { fill: var(--k-kulit); } .kulit2 { fill: var(--k-kulit2); } .rambut { fill: var(--k-rambut); }
      .baju { fill: var(--k-baju); } .baju2 { fill: none; stroke: var(--k-baju2); stroke-width: 10; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; }

      .laptop { fill: var(--k-laptop); } .laptop2 { fill: var(--k-laptop2); }
      /* Kartu foto: 220 x 360, bingkai krem 3 px, sudut 17 px, bayangan kecil. Posisi diatur skrip (orbit). */
      .kartu { position: absolute; left: 0; top: 0; width: 180px; height: 295px; border: 3px solid var(--kartu-bingkai); border-radius: 14px;

      .kartu svg { display: block; width: 100%; height: 100%; }
      /* Judul di atas rekaman: baris putih berbayang, baris kedua di kotak warna utama. */
      .scene { position: absolute; inset: 0; z-index: 40; visibility: hidden; pointer-events: none; }

      .sorot { position: absolute; left: 0; top: 0; width: 900px; height: 1080px; z-index: 39;

  <body>
    <div id="root" data-composition-id="main" data-start="0" data-duration="15" data-width="1920" data-height="1080" data-fps="30">
      <!-- Footage pengguna: satu <video> klip upl_… dari list_media di bawah,
           lalu cutout orangnya video cutout cut_… dari make_cutout di .orang (z-index 20) dengan waktu yang sama (cutoutTiming). -->
      <div class="ruang"><div class="atap"></div><div class="jendela"></div><div class="tirai"></div><div class="lampu"></div></div>
      <svg class="orang" viewBox="0 0 1080 1920">
        <path class="baju" d="M110 1920 L140 1340 Q165 1190 320 1150 L455 1112 Q540 1160 625 1112 L760 1150 Q915 1190 940 1340 L970 1920 Z" />
        <path class="baju2" d="M455 1116 L498 1196 L540 1158 L582 1196 L625 1116 M540 1158 V1300" />
        <path class="kulit2" d="M474 985 L470 1118 Q540 1168 610 1118 L606 985 Z" />
        <g id="kepala"><g transform="translate(540 1080) scale(0.86) translate(-540 -1080)">
          <ellipse class="kulit2" cx="372" cy="880" rx="28" ry="52" /><ellipse class="kulit2" cx="708" cy="880" rx="28" ry="52" />
          <path class="kulit" d="M540 652 C652 652 712 734 712 864 C712 994 640 1076 540 1076 C440 1076 368 994 368 864 C368 734 428 652 540 652 Z" />
          <path class="rambut" d="M360 860 C342 700 430 604 548 604 C668 604 742 690 722 860 C712 770 668 716 604 704 C548 730 452 732 396 712 C374 760 366 806 360 860 Z" />
          <path class="alis" d="M432 812 q36 -18 74 -4 M574 808 q38 -14 74 4" />
          <g id="mata"><ellipse class="putih" cx="470" cy="862" rx="30" ry="17" /><ellipse class="putih" cx="610" cy="862" rx="30" ry="17" />
            <circle class="mata" cx="472" cy="862" r="13" /><circle class="mata" cx="608" cy="862" r="13" /></g>

        <!-- laptop di depan badan: bagian rekaman, bukan grafis -->

        <path class="laptop" d="M40 1610 L860 1648 L878 1920 L18 1920 Z" />

    <script>
      const tl = gsap.timeline({ paused: true });
      // Foto di kartu: enam lukisan SVG sederhana (pengganti foto pengguna dari list_media).
      const FOTO = [
        `<rect width="220" height="360" style="fill:var(--p-langit)"/><path d="M0 150 H120 V360 H0 Z" style="fill:var(--p-biru)"/><path d="M120 120 H220 V360 H60 V320 H90 V280 H120 V240 H150 V200 H180 V160 H220" style="fill:var(--p-pink)"/><path d="M120 120 V360" style="stroke:var(--p-pink2);stroke-width:8"/>`,
        `<rect width="220" height="360" style="fill:var(--p-merah)"/><ellipse cx="110" cy="240" rx="92" ry="34" style="fill:var(--p-krem)"/><path d="M50 236 V170 Q110 130 170 170 V236 Q110 262 50 236 Z" style="fill:var(--p-coklat)"/><path d="M50 176 Q110 140 170 176 Q110 206 50 176 Z" style="fill:var(--p-pink)"/><circle cx="110" cy="150" r="12" style="fill:var(--p-merah)"/>`,
        `<rect width="220" height="360" style="fill:var(--p-pink)"/><rect y="250" width="220" height="110" style="fill:var(--p-pink2)"/><path d="M96 260 V120 Q110 96 124 120 V260 Z M60 200 V160 Q72 146 84 160 V214 H96 M160 186 V144 Q148 130 136 144 V200 H124" style="fill:var(--p-hijau)"/>`,
        `<rect width="220" height="360" style="fill:var(--p-oranye)"/><rect width="220" height="150" style="fill:var(--p-kuning)"/><circle cx="110" cy="200" r="54" style="fill:var(--p-krem)"/><rect y="220" width="220" height="140" style="fill:var(--p-laut)"/><path d="M20 260 H200 M50 300 H170" style="stroke:var(--p-krem);stroke-width:6"/>`,
        `<rect width="220" height="360" style="fill:var(--p-coklat)"/><circle cx="110" cy="180" r="76" style="fill:var(--p-krem)"/><circle cx="110" cy="180" r="56" style="fill:var(--p-coklat)"/><path d="M90 180 q20 -30 40 0 q-20 30 -40 0" style="fill:var(--p-krem)"/><path d="M186 180 h22" style="stroke:var(--p-krem);stroke-width:14;stroke-linecap:round"/>`,
        `<rect width="220" height="360" style="fill:var(--p-krem)"/><g style="fill:var(--p-ungu)"><rect x="40" y="120" width="40" height="40"/><rect x="80" y="160" width="40" height="40"/><rect x="40" y="200" width="40" height="40"/></g><g style="fill:var(--p-kuning)"><rect x="120" y="120" width="40" height="40"/><rect x="80" y="200" width="40" height="40"/><rect x="120" y="200" width="40" height="40"/></g><g style="fill:var(--p-merah)"><rect x="80" y="120" width="40" height="40"/><rect x="120" y="160" width="40" height="40"/><rect x="40" y="160" width="40" height="40"/></g><rect x="96" y="80" width="12" height="40" style="fill:var(--p-hijau)"/>`,
      ];
      const URUT = [1, 0, 4, 2, 5, 0, 3, 1];
      const cincin = document.getElementById("cincin");
      const kartu = URUT.map((f) => {
        const el = document.createElement("div");
        el.className = "kartu";
        el.innerHTML = `<svg viewBox="0 0 220 360" preserveAspectRatio="xMidYMid slice">${FOTO[f]}</svg>`;
        return cincin.appendChild(el);
      });
      // Cincin 3D palsu: lingkaran miring dihitung sendiri, diproyeksikan dengan perspektif 1400 px dari (1280, 565).
      // Kartu i di sudut 80 - 45i derajat, berputar 35,5 derajat per detik; z < 0 di belakang orang, z > 0 di depan.
      const R = { cx: 1280, cy: 650, rx: 470, ry: 140, rz: 290, p: 1400, ox: 1280, oy: 565, w: 180, h: 295, laju: 35.5 };
      const D = Math.PI / 180;
      function orbit(t) {
        kartu.forEach((el, i) => {
          const a = (80 - 45 * i - R.laju * t) * D, sn = Math.sin(a), cs = Math.cos(a), z = R.rz * cs;
          const s = R.p / (R.p - z), x = R.ox + (R.cx + R.rx * sn - R.ox) * s, y = R.oy + (R.cy + R.ry * cs - R.oy) * s;
          const rY = -24 * sn;
          gsap.set(el, { x: x - R.w / 2, y: y - R.h / 2, scaleX: s * Math.cos(rY * D), scaleY: s, skewY: rY * 0.22, rotation: -3 * sn,
            zIndex: z < 0 ? 1 + Math.round((z + R.rz) / 40) : 30 + Math.round(z / 40) });
        });
      }
      // Orang pengganti: kepala mengangguk pelan, berkedip, mulut bicara (jeda di antara kalimat).
      const JEDA = [[4.3, 4.7], [8.4, 8.8], [12.0, 12.4], [14.2, 15]];
      function hidup(t) {
        const diam = JEDA.some(([a, b]) => t > a && t < b);
        const buka = diam ? 0.15 : 0.2 + 0.8 * Math.abs(Math.sin(t * 13.7) * Math.sin(t * 4.1 + 1.3));
        gsap.set("#mulut", { scaleY: buka, transformOrigin: "50% 50%" });
        gsap.set("#kepala", { rotation: 2.2 * Math.sin(t * 1.3), y: 9 * Math.sin(t * 2.6 + 0.5), svgOrigin: "540 1090" });
        const k = (t % 3.4) / 0.16;
        gsap.set("#mata", { scaleY: k < 1 ? 1 - 0.9 * Math.sin(k * Math.PI) : 1, transformOrigin: "50% 50%" });
      }
      const jam = { t: 0 };
      orbit(0); hidup(0);
      tl.to(jam, { t: 15, duration: 15, ease: "none", onUpdate: () => { orbit(jam.t); hidup(jam.t); } }, 0);
      // Judul berganti tiap ketukan; kotak baris kedua menyapu masuk dari tengah.
      const cut = (from, to, at) => tl.set(from, { visibility: "hidden" }, at).set(to, { visibility: "visible" }, at);
      [["#s1", 0], ["#s2", 4.5], ["#s3", 8.6], ["#s4", 12.2]].forEach(([s, at], i, all) => {
        if (i) cut(all[i - 1][0], s, at);
        tl.fromTo(`${s} .judul`, { y: 18, opacity: 0 }, { y: 0, opacity: 1, duration: 0.22, ease: "power2.out" }, at + 0.05);
        tl.fromTo(`${s} .kotak`, { scaleX: 0 }, { scaleX: 1, duration: 0.2, ease: "power3.out" }, at + 0.16);
      });
      window.__timelines = window.__timelines || {};
      window.__timelines.main = tl;
    </script>
